annotations.title: Check a robots.txt file for AI bot access

description: Same report as doorman_check_site, for robots.txt text you already have (a draft, or a file from a site the checker cannot reach). Parses it the way crawlers do (RFC 9309 groups, longest-match Allow/Disallow, * and $ wildcards) and reports which AI training bots, AI search bots, assistants and search engines it lets in, plus the shared __usage_ai-training preference.

robots_txt.description: The full robots.txt text (up to 512 KB). Empty means no robots.txt.
